family.shared_definition: a large, detached mass of solid mineral material
family.semantic_notes: 'Boulder' specifically denotes a large, rounded or detached rock, whereas 'rock' spans any size and mass.

source_context_dev: Centuries of glacial meltwater had polished the alpine canyon floor into massive, seamless domes. Navigating the rounded monoliths required friction-based footholds along the slick contours.

The river gorge was carved out of gigantic rounded slabs that had been buffed by seasonal torrents. Ascending the towering geological formation demanded steady balance across its frictionless surface.
Millennia of rushing water had ground down the colossal formations at the base of the waterfall. Progress stalled as the team searched for traction against the glassy, rounded mass.
The ancient stream bed was dominated by enormous rounded mounds that offered virtually no edges. Team members relied on rubber grip alone to traverse the polished surface.
target_context_dev: The crumbling gully was filled with unstable scree that shifted under the slightest pressure. Each step threatened to trigger a cascade of unstable debris down the ravine.
Years of frost wedging had fractured the cliffside into dangerously unstable fragments. Stepping onto the shifting rubble required extreme vigilance to prevent dangerous slides.
The steep talus slope consisted of precarious fragments resting delicately on gravel. Every movement risked dislodging pieces from the unstable incline.
Wind and ice had eroded the slope into precarious debris prone to rolling downward. Moving forward required testing each unstable chunk before placing full bodyweight.

The source context highlights large-scale polished/rounded formations to pragmatically bias toward 'smooth boulder', while the target context highlights crumbling/unstable scree to bias toward 'loose rock'.
